sourceInformation.tech: my-3dge at e7a1243, three.js r182 on WebGPU, Rapier 0.21, Vite 7.3, TypeScript.
sourceInformation.artDirection: The engine toon style, with a bright lawn, sand shore, and a flat sea.
sourceInformation.animation: The engine clip layer. Original poses are scrubbed from the balance step. The rest pose is Mesh2Motion.
sourceInformation.audio: Tracker songs, code-made effects, and gibberish syllable voices. A fresh save plays music at a tenth.
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub Session Protocol v1, ghost mode, and same-screen Group Class on its own.
sourceInformation.testing: Bot bands on ten seeds, a three-seed walk to the credits, and browser checks of the built file.

testingFeedback: Testing caught six issues before hand-in. They were score bands, a NaN prop yaw, a missing boot setting, over-long lines, a ghost pack at the wrong offset, and event imports one folder too high.
Four were critical. The bands, the island boot, the ghost seat, and the event imports each stopped a run.
The most helpful test was the four bot bands on ten seeds for every shipped activity.
The least helpful was a headless screenshot. The canvas can be blank while the sim state is fine.
engineFeedback: Scene actions, live settings, and a headless world you can step made the week testable without a browser.
I got stuck on playClip during setup, props that need a yaw, a frozen recorded world, and hub query keys read as settings.
The balance step, the day director, the songs, and the syllable voices are the game’s own.
The hardest part was keeping the pavilion small enough for the hub ready deadline while the island stayed a place.
None. The engine files were not changed.
I would let a page add a mesh, and I would start the music bus at a tenth instead of a half.
promptFeedback: The acceptance numbers, the cut line, and the bot bands made the scope checkable.
The group score is described as a sum to 3000 and also has to fit a rank from 0 to 1000. Several seed lines are longer than two sentences.
The hardest part was one HTML file that is a full retreat and also a ghost session the harness can drive.
I would state the group score once, and pin the session client hash to the file the plan says to fetch.

aiHub.name: Thumb Yoga
aiHub.tagline: A week of balance at Little Fulcrum
aiHub.description: Stand on the disc and keep the dot near the middle. Little Fulcrum runs five days of pose, pond, water, sand, and a storm.
aiHub.controls: Lean with the left stick, WASD or the mouse. L2 and R2, or Q and E, are the feet. Both feet or Space breathe.
